items.question: Do guests need an app?
items.answer: No. Every guest, driver, vendor and the hotel desk gets a link that opens in their browser.

items.question: How is this different from an event on {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: An event is one evening with tickets. A programme is several functions over days, with households, travel, rooms and the people who look after them.

items.question: Do guests pay through {{brand.name}}?
items.answer: No. You pay for the programme. Guests reply and add their travel and IDs; nobody buys a ticket.

items.question: What happens to guests’ IDs?
items.answer: Only the hotel front desk and your team can see them, every view is logged, and they’re deleted three days after the last checkout.

items.question: Can family or a sponsor see how it’s going?
items.answer: Yes, with a numbers-only link: who’s coming to what and who hasn’t replied, without names, phone numbers or rooms.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Book a 15-minute walkthrough. We look at your guest list and how the weekend runs, then send a quote.
